content.name: Dray McFarlane
content.title: Junior Software Developer
content.tagline: I build web and mobile apps, and I'm always learning and growing as a developer.
content.about: I'm Dray, a junior software developer who enjoys turning ideas into useful web and mobile apps. I graduated from the University College of the Cayman Islands in June 2025 with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (3.50 GPA) and earned my CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Management) in April 2025. Each role so far has added something new to my toolkit, from databases and CI/CD to mobile development, and I'm a quick learner who loves picking up the next technology.

highlights: Contributed across the full software development lifecycle on web and mobile projects, from design to support
Gained hands-on experience managing CI/CD pipelines and helping coordinate system migrations
Broadened my skills with Oracle APEX and PL/SQL alongside modern web and mobile technologies
Built a strong foundation in machines, networking and servers
Contributed to application development while delivering great customer service
Took responsibility for the firm's server backups
Learned to document applications with data dictionaries, ER diagrams and user manuals
